retrievalProfile.description: A group portrait of five men in coordinated white shirts and dark trousers posing dynamically on a construction beam high above a blue-toned city skyline.
triggerTerms: men posing on a steel beam

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle medium shot of five men standing on a rusted orange steel girder. They are dressed in crisp white button-down shirts and dark indigo denim, arranged in a rhythmic, overlapping line. The background is a dense, hazy blue cityscape of skyscrapers with visible window lights, creating a sense of extreme altitude and urban energy.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the warm orange of the foreground beam and the cool blue city background
Rhythmic repetition of the men's white shirts against the dark pants and blue sky
Verticality of the skyscrapers echoing the upright but dynamic poses of the subjects
Diagonal line of the suspension rope on the right balancing the horizontal beam
coreInvariants: High-contrast sans-serif typography in the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically, standing on a beam at the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rusted orange steel beam at the bottom provides a solid horizontal base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the horizontal line of the men from left to right, then moves up to the bold typography in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is relatively open, occupied by the hazy sky and distant buildings.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blue and grey tones in the cityscape background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white of the shirts and the bright white of the primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rusted orange/brown of the steel beam and yellow for the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between shirts and pants; low saturation in the background to emphasize the foreground subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical orientation for secondary prefix text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between ultra-condensed white sans-serif and wide yellow slab-serif.
graphicDevices: Vertical text orientation for minor elements
Horizontal rule-like alignment of text blocks

preserve: Condensed proportions of the main title
Yellow color for the secondary title
avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the primary title.
Provides the necessary weight and slab-serif structure for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of five men in white shirts and dark blue jeans posing on a rusty orange steel beam high above a blue-toned 1980s city skyline at dusk.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed bold white sans-serif text in the top right, with a secondary line of wide yellow slab-serif text immediately below it.

verificationChecks: Are the men wearing white shirts and dark pants?
Is the city background predominantly blue and hazy?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper corner?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Intensity of the blue haze in the background

mustAchieve: Clear separation between foreground beam and background city
High-contrast lighting on the white shirts
avoid: Cluttered typography that obscures the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Check that the beam appears to be at a high altitude.
Ensure the white shirts are bright and not greyed out.
Verify the typography is sharp and legible against the sky.
Confirm the color palette maintains the blue/orange contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Height Group Portrait + [Subject Description] + [Skyline Era] + [High-Contrast Condensed Type]
